# nullsuf: written by build.sh from toys/nullsuf.y; do not edit.
level left T
level left HIGH
rule 0 s: X a T Z
rule 1 s: Y a
rule 2 a: b opt opt2
rule 3 opt:
rule 4 opt: Q
rule 5 opt2:
rule 6 opt2: P
rule 7 b: W %prec HIGH
rule 8 b: W T R
refuse	-	X
refuse	-	Y
refuse	-	X W
accept	7:1-2,3:2-2,5:2-2,2:1-2,1:0-2	Y W
refuse	-	X W P
refuse	-	X W Q
refuse	-	X W T
accept	7:1-2,3:2-2,6:2-3,2:1-3,1:0-3	Y W P
accept	7:1-2,4:2-3,5:3-3,2:1-3,1:0-3	Y W Q
refuse	-	Y W T
refuse	-	X W P T
refuse	-	X W Q P
refuse	-	X W Q T
refuse	-	X W T R
accept	7:1-2,3:2-2,5:2-2,2:1-2,0:0-4	X W T Z
accept	7:1-2,4:2-3,6:3-4,2:1-4,1:0-4	Y W Q P
refuse	-	Y W T R
accept	7:1-2,3:2-2,6:2-3,2:1-3,0:0-5	X W P T Z
refuse	-	X W Q P T
accept	7:1-2,4:2-3,5:3-3,2:1-3,0:0-5	X W Q T Z
refuse	-	X W T R P
refuse	-	X W T R Q
refuse	-	X W T R T
refuse	-	Y W T R P
refuse	-	Y W T R Q
accept	7:1-2,4:2-3,6:3-4,2:1-4,0:0-6	X W Q P T Z
refuse	-	X W T R P T
refuse	-	X W T R Q T
refuse	-	X W T R T Z
refuse	-	Y W T R Q P
refuse	-	X W T R P T Z
refuse	-	X W T R Q T Z
